text: dsh-docks 在 DSH 中托管本地网页应用，按名称提供本地路由，并支持 HTTP 与 WebSocket 转发。用户可通过 agent 工具列出应用、查看状态和启动、停止或重启进程；可选侧边栏提供状态及控制按钮。期望运行状态保存在本地。每个应用配置启动命令与端口，或受支持的本地 HTTP 地址；服务默认监听 127.0.0.1:3081。

dsh-docks hosts local web apps in DSH through named routes. Its agent tool lists apps and manages processes; an optional sidebar shows status and controls. Desired state is saved locally. Configure app commands and ports or local HTTP addresses. It listens on 127.0.0.1:3081 by default.
我想在 DSH 里打开本机运行的网页应用。
能不能从 DSH 对话里启动或停止一个本地应用？
让 DSH 帮我查看托管应用现在是否运行。
我想在侧边栏看到应用状态并快速打开网页。
本地应用崩溃后，希望它能自动尝试重启。
I want to open my local web apps inside DSH.
Can I start, stop, or restart a local app from an agent tool?
Show me which docked apps are running and let me open them in a sidebar.
dsh-docks 的功能「按应用名称访问网页」：为配置的应用提供 name.localhost 地址，并将 HTTP 请求代理到本地应用端口；WebSocket 连接也转发到应用。访问应用时使用对应名称的本地地址。
dsh-docks 的功能「管理应用进程」：agent 可调用 docks 工具列出应用、查看状态、启动、停止或重启指定应用，并获得操作结果。
dsh-docks 的功能「侧边栏控制面板」：在 better-sidebar 可用时注册 docks 标签页，显示应用状态并提供打开、启动、停止和重启按钮。
dsh-docks 的功能「恢复期望运行状态」：将用户启动或停止应用后的期望状态写入本地 JSON 文件，重新初始化时据此恢复应用。

dsh-docks README · dsh-docks：A generic web-app docking system for DeepSeek Harness: any local web service (marimo, Pluto.jl, gradio, streamlit…) enters dsh via a one-line declaration and runs alongside the agent session. Zero rewriting, zero translation — just `*.localhost` wildcard host routing + iframe.

dsh-docks README · Form Factor (v2)：docks is a **pure host docking service**; the UI is delegated to [DSH-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar):

- **Docked content**: open `http://<name>.localhost:3081/` in better-sidebar's embedded browser tab
- **Dock control**: better-sidebar's "docks" tab (app list + status dot + start/stop + open)
- **agent tool**: say "start marimo" in conversation, or call the `docks` tool directly (list/status/start/stop/restart)

dsh-docks README · Prerequisites：- Install `dsh-better-sidebar` (`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar`)
- In better-sidebar settings enable `browserNoSandbox` (globally disables the sandbox; accepts the "all web pages and GUI share an origin" tradeoff, only for locally trusted apps)
- (Optional) enable `agentOpenTools` so the model can push URLs straight to the browser tab via `sidebar_open`

dsh-docks README · Usage：1. `docks list` (in conversation or via the agent tool) → get `http://marimo.localhost:3081/`
2. Open the URL (sidebar_open or type it in the address bar) → marimo runs in the browser tab
3. The "docks" control-panel tab → see all app states at a glance, start/stop, click "↗" to open the browser tab

dsh-docks README · Architecture：- host: `node:http` listens on `127.0.0.1:3081`, reverse-proxying to the app's real port by the Host header; injects `FRAME_SCRIPT` to collapse same-origin opens back into the iframe (docking semantics); serves `/_docks/state`, `/_docks/command`, `/docks/api/origin`
- client: a control-panel tab registered with better-sidebar (soft-dep; without it, pure agent tooling)
- agent: the `docks` tool (list/status/start/stop/restart)

dsh-docks README · Configuration Reference：Declarations hang under `- id: docks / config` in the profile patch. `listen.host` only allows `127.0.0.1` (v1 does not offer 0.0.0.0; the security posture matches the dsh main service).

dsh-docks README · Configuration Reference：| field | default | description |
|---|---|---|
| `listen.host` | `127.0.0.1` | 127.0.0.1 only |
| `listen.port` | `3081` | port the docks panel service listens on (when taken, activation fails with a hint to change this value) |
| `restarts.maxConsecutive` | `3` | consecutive-crash restart limit; exhausted → `failed` |
| `restarts.stableUptimeMs` | `60000` | running continuously past this duration resets the restart counter |
| `restarts.backoffMs` | `1000, 2000, 4000` | crash-restart backoff sequence (caps at the last value; the counter resets after continuous running ≥ stableUptimeMs) |
| `apps[]` | `[]` | list of app declarations, see below |

dsh-docks README · Configuration Reference：App declarations come in two levels (v1 implements L0+L1):

**L1 managed** (docks handles start/stop, probing, crash restart, desired-state restore)

dsh-docks README · Configuration Reference：| field | default | description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | required | the subdomain; must match `^[a-z0-9-]+$`, no duplicates |
| `title` | `name` | display name |
| `command` | required for L1 | executable (mutually exclusive with `external`) |
| `args` | `[]` | command-line arguments |
| `port` | required for L1 | the port the app actually listens on (pre-checked for occupancy before spawn) |
| `cwd` / `env` | — | working directory / string environment variables |
| `healthPath` | `/` | HTTP probe path, expecting a ready response (<500) |
| `healthTimeoutMs` | `120000` | probe timeout (Pluto's first-boot precompilation can take a minute or two; 30000 suggested for marimo) |
| `startup` | `manual` | `manual` starts on demand; `auto` starts on activation (a per-app exception) |
| `mode` | `attached` | `detached` is accepted by the schema but v1 returns a "not implemented" error |

dsh-docks README · Configuration Reference：**L0 pure access** (no process; router passes straight through; the status dot `unreachable` means the external service is unreachable)

| field | description |
|---|---|
| `name` | same as above |
| `external` | required for L0, only supports local `http://127.0.0.1:` addresses, and must not be used with `command` |

dsh-docks README · Separating Compute from Observation (Security Note)：**Heavy simulation does not go into docks.** Run multi-core / long-running compute itself under tmux / systemd / slurm; docks only hosts the "observation surface" web app. docks shares dsh's lifecycle — a dsh crash takes attached app processes with it. The right posture: run compute in an external session and declare, in docks, only an L0 pure access pointing at its UI port (`external: http://127.0.0.1:8501`). The command/state endpoints listen on loopback only and reject cross-origin Origins.
